# Forest index

> The foundation's index of Forest. It ranks what is public: it reads the hosts it lists, keeps the profiles whose verification (a proof that the person behind the profile holds a stamp from a verifier this index counts as checking one real person) checks for a verifier key it lists, ranks each within its market, and serves what it finds as pages for people and as JSON for machines. Each profile shows its ratings (a weighted average from 1 to 10, as it is, with how many raters), its trust (0 to 100: it starts at 50; vouches and ratings raise it, reports lower it) and its uniqueness (0 to 100: how sure the index is that it is one real person), signed. Each review, vouch or report a profile gives weighs its uniqueness times its trust. Each profile is one person's profile in one market and role; nothing here links one profile to another.

Every page has a JSON twin at the same address with `.json` on its path. Any AI that can read the web can read and browse these pages by links, from the home page to each market, each listing and its profile, with nothing to install and no login: no key and no sign-up. A fold on each profile's page, What these mean, says what its rating, trust and uniqueness mean.

## For AI agents

- [Read skill](https://index.forest.foundation/skill.md): every field and filter in plain words: how to search, read a market and a profile, and what ratings, trust and uniqueness mean
- [Markets](https://index.forest.foundation/index.json): every market, this index's address, and the lists it reads by
- [About](https://index.forest.foundation/about.json): this index's address, the lists it reads by, and the credit for the names of places; [its page](https://index.forest.foundation/about) says what this index is, what it reads and its address
- A market, at `https://index.forest.foundation/markets/<name>`, its twin with `.json`: its file, its status and its preview among the rest, the listings this index lists, by role, and one side of them with search's filters, such as `?role=<role>&where=madrid`
- A listing, at `https://index.forest.foundation/profiles/<address>/listing/<id>`, its twin with `.json`: its photos, its fields in its market's order, its places named, who posted it, what that profile shows and its two latest reviews, and how to reach them
- [Search](https://index.forest.foundation/search.json?q=maths&market=tutoring): listings matching words and filters, a market's own fields among them, Top rated by their ratings with the market's average added, so few scores sit near it; near a place, by its name (`where`) or its point (`near`), the listings whose place reaches it, each with its distance in km, nearest first with `sort=near`; with a price filter in one currency and per, cheapest first with `sort=price`
- [Sitemap](https://index.forest.foundation/sitemap.xml): the home page, each market, each counted profile, and each listing this index lists
- [Reputation tree](https://index.forest.foundation/v1/reputation): this index's signed root, and [every leaf](https://index.forest.foundation/v1/reputation/leaves), each a profile's trust, for carrying a trust from one's own profiles without naming them

## How it works

- [What it reads, how it scores, and every number it uses](https://github.com/foundationforest/services/blob/main/index/README.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/foundationforest/services): open; anyone can run another index
